definitions.explanation: An administrative division of a city.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}には23{区|く}がある。
{渋谷区|しぶやく}の{図書館|としょかん}で{本|ほん}を{借|か}りた。
examples.english: I borrowed a book from the Shibuya Ward library.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しをしたので、{新|あたら}しい{区|く}の{役所|やくしょ}で{住所|じゅうしょ}{変更|へんこう}の{手続|てつづ}きをした。
examples.english: Since I moved, I did the address change procedure at the new ward office.

notes:
〜{区|く} indicates a ward or district.

USAGE:
- Major cities in Japan are divided into wards
- Tokyo has 23 special wards ({特別区|とくべつく})

EXAMPLES:
- {渋谷区|しぶやく}: Shibuya Ward
- {港区|みなとく}: Minato Ward
- {中央区|ちゅうおうく}: Chuo Ward

RELATED:
- {市|し}: city
- {町|ちょう/まち}: town
- {村|そん/むら}: village
